projects.title: Noitero
projects.description: A Noita-inspired spell-crafting roguelite. Built a fully modular spell system: composable projectiles, trajectory modifiers (boomerang, zig-zag, arc) and damage/speed multipliers chained at runtime.

projects.title: RogueFPS
projects.description: A roguelite first-person shooter built around custom weapon and status-effect systems: nail gun, electric SMG, glue revolver and repulsor. Wave spawning, ragdolls and game feel polish.

projects.title: Jedi Monkey: Total War
projects.description: Game Dev Party Jam 2023. Play a fighting monkey who's secretly a Jedi: defend against enemy waves from every side of the arena and survive for the highest score. I built the main character mechanics.

projects.title: Paper Feel
projects.description: First-year group project: a FeelGood cinematic platformer made in two months. I worked on character mechanics, asset integration and level building, plus lighting and the animator.

projects.title: Project: Magnet Person
projects.description: A first-person puzzle game on the theme Duality. Subject 710N37 flips his magnetic polarity to interact with the lab and escape. I reworked the mechanics, level design and game feel after the jam.

tools.title: FlowSys: Mission System
tools.description: A modular mission/flow framework for Unity. SOLID architecture with a state machine, ScriptableObject-driven config, extensible actions and conditions, plus custom editor windows with localization support.

tools.title: Freelance Invoice Creator
tools.description: A standalone in-browser tool to build clean freelance invoices and export them to PDF, no backend, no signup. Built for my own freelance workflow.

tools.title: Navimancie: Card Builder
tools.description: An in-browser card designer for my game Navimancie: lay out card art, stats and text, then export print-ready cards. A custom tool to iterate on card content fast.
